text:
Maya (infra): Kickoff: europe-south1 kubeadm cluster turnup for GPU inference fleet. Bare-metal-ish VMs on GCP, 3 control-plane, 6 util nodes, 4 A10 GPU nodes. Goal: production-ready dev/test pool by EOD. Need infra signoff + oncall ramp.
Raj (k8s): Copy. Which node composition exactly? taints/labels? storage? CNI?

Maya (infra): Plan:
- control-plane: 3 CP (external LB via cloud LB)
- infra nodes: 3 general purpose (monitoring, logging, registry cache)
- gpu nodes: two pools: a10-24g (3 nodes), a10-24g-burst (1 node) 
- container runtime: containerd (systemd cgroup)
- CNI: Calico policy-only with MTU 1400 (vpc mtu 1460 -> iptables overhead)
- taints: nvidia=true:NoSchedule on GPU nodes
- labels: node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true, workload=inference
- storage: local-ssd ephemeral for /var/lib/docker, PVCs on managed PV later

Sam (runtime): Ack. Make sure kernel params for hugepages and vm.max_map_count set, and swap off. Also set vm.panic_on_oom=0?

Raj (k8s): Add to checklist:
- disable swap: `swapoff -a` and remove fstab entry
- sysctl: `net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables=1`, `net.ipv4.ip_forward=1`, `vm.max_map_count=262144`

Maya (infra): Bootstrap commands (high-level):
```
# on control plane
kubeadm init --config=eu-south1-turnup.yaml --upload-certs
# generate join token if needed
kubeadm token create --print-join-command
# on workers
kubeadm join <lb-ip>:6443 --token <token> --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash sha256:<hash>
```
Will push the exact config file to infra repo after smoke pass.

Infra CI: CI: ran smoke-conformance (quick) against the initial CP. Failed: calico-node CrashLoopBackOff due to MTU mismatch. Logs:
```
calico-node: failed to allocate route: link has MTU 1500, expected 1400
kubectl logs -n kube-system calico-node-xxxxx
```

Sam (runtime): That matches. Set Calico Felix config MTU=1400 and daemonset env. Also ensure kube-proxy mode is ipvs and conntrack max tuned.

Maya (infra): Will patch calico configmap before joining more nodes. Also pre-pull images on GPU nodes to speed bring-up: `quay.io/nvidia/k8s-device-plugin:1.0.0`, `nvcr.io/nvidia/operator:1.9.0`, `registry.redwood/runner:stable`.

Raj (k8s): GPU driver plan? Use nvidia-operator or deb package? We prefer operator to keep lifecycle consistent. Add node annotations for driver version pin.

Maya (infra): Using nvidia-operator with the following quick steps:
1) install operator CRDs
2) apply NodeFeatureDiscovery to detect GPUs
3) apply DevicePlugin DaemonSet
Will also enable K8s device-plugin health checks and NodeReadiness gates.

Sam (runtime): Pod manifest for perf check (small):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: gpu-smoke
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    node.kubernetes.io/gpu: "true"
  tolerations:
  - key: "nvidia"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  containers:
  - name: smoke
    image: nvidia/cuda:11.7-base
    command: ["/bin/sh","-c","nvidia-smi && sleep 30"]
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```

Maya (infra): Cost controls: set cluster-autoscaler with scale-down-enabled=true, balance-similar-node-groups, GPU nodegroup min=0 max=6, scale-down-unneeded-time=10m. We'll attach billing alert: daily expected spend threshold 3k USD to slack alert.

Raj (k8s): Networking gotcha: ensure cloud routes for pod CIDR exist and the VPC MTU set matches calico MTU, otherwise kube-proxy fails. Also bump `max_pods` on GPU instances.

Infra CI: CI: post-patch run shows calico running, kube-system green except for kube-proxy flapping on one node (ipvs failure) - resolution attempt: reload ipvs kernel modules + restart kube-proxy. Logs:
```
modprobe ip_vs
systemctl restart kube-proxy
kubectl get pods -n kube-system
```

Sam (runtime): Important: containerd snapshotter tuning for GPU images (use native snapshotter or registry mirror) — add registry mirror in containerd config to avoid throttling.

Maya (infra): Handoff plan -> oncall at 19:00 UTC takes ownership. Handoff checklist (one-liner items):
- verify control-plane endpoints (curl https://<lb-ip>:6443/healthz)
- kubectl get nodes && ensure Ready==true for all nodes
- run gpu-smoke pod and confirm nvidia-smi output
- check calico felix metrics for dropped packets
- run small perf job (sample inference container) and confirm latency within baseline
- confirm cluster-autoscaler logs and expected scale behavior
- validate kubelet cgroup driver and containerd config across nodes
- verify kube-apiserver cert expiry (certs rotate)

Raj (k8s): Add: check kubelet systemd dropin for `--fail-swap-on=false` (we disable swap permanently), and ensure node-exporter has nvml metrics.

oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Paging policy updated: primary oncall is Sam (runtime) from 19:00 UTC -> 03:00 UTC, fallback Raj. Handoff note posted to #oncall-handoffs.

Maya (infra): Final: I'll open PR with `eu-south1-turnup.yaml`, calico MTU patch, and a small operating runbook snippet. Ping me if you see any post-join flakes.

Sam (runtime): I'll be oncall and will validate GPU perf test at 19:05 UTC. Good to go from my side. :thumbsup:

Raj (k8s): I'll follow the PR and validate autoscaler config.

Maya (infra): Thanks team — rolling bring-up now. Will update thread with PR link and final smoke logs.
